formulas.e_consensus: per run: residual = delta - median(delta), z = residual / (1.4826*MAD + eps); E sample: z1*z2 > 0 and abs(mean(delta1, delta2)) >= 1.0; severity: abs(mean(z1, z2)) > 2.5 -> severe, > 1.5 -> soft
formulas.b_rule: severe: abs(B) > 1.5 and direction_consistency >= 3; soft: abs(B) > 1.0 and direction_consistency >= 2
formulas.b_consensus: rule 'mean_and_rerun_conservative' (operative adjudication, not a natural symmetric consensus): members = flagged by the frozen B rule on the two-run mean profile; severity = severe only when the mean profile and the rerun both flag severe; the rerun serves as the review run in this project's precision-upgrade timeline

b_route_metric.source: arithmetic mean of per-run B counts (run1/run2)

b_consensus_samples.variants_usage: archived for audit only; must not drive sample roles or gates

budgets.derivation: 原始：训练 36×2=72，验证 12×2=24，分析 1 次 + 1 次重试；2026-09-21 修正（操作性裁定）：候选 1 已耗 17 → 17+96（候选 2 完整链路）=113 次评分成功，113+2 分析=115 总成功；attempts 110→220 以吸收实测 SSL 传输重试

sources.scoring: 执行启动时的终端回显；无逐请求归档

legacy_labels.b_validation_report_reason: legacy label 'cap_reached' is retained for provenance; B history is not rewritten

candidate_rule_constraints: one dimension / one candidate / one rule / at most one non-semantic retry
qualitative wording only: no fixed scores, percentages or score floors
must not duplicate rules already present in the frozen final prompt
must not alter other scoring dimensions
must be injected under the existing 结构分特殊情形 anchor
must not add new top-level sections
must pass the existing prompt structure contract

rule_selection_policy.description: 按响应数组原序取第 1 条，在其上执行 Gate 0 硬拒绝检查（注入位置/范围/硬阈值/证据池/重复/契约预算）；未通过则顺延至下一条；全部未通过则 E_NO_VALID_CANDIDATE；不做前筛选排序；已归档响应不得重发请求
rule_selection_policy.admission_ruling: 2026-09-21 裁定：硬审查通过即进入测试流程，此节点不设人工通过点；人工否决权保留至执行开始前；全部门禁通过后仍停在 E_CANDIDATE_PASSED_AWAITING_HUMAN，无自动晋升
rule_selection_policy.rationale: 惰性补全：最小机械干预，避免引入人工权重与选择偏差

budget_amendments.ruling: 候选 1（响应序 0）首评门被拒（对照 20 号 structure Δ+2.0）后：人工裁定顺延至第二条规则（响应序 1），并授权预算扩大到足够第二条完整链路
budget_amendments.derivation: 17（候选 1 已耗）+96（候选 2 链路）=113；attempts 110→220 以吸收实测 SSL 传输重试

process_amendments.ruling: 候选 1/2 均被首评门拒后：授权候选 3（响应序 2）仅做首评快筛（micro_r1，17 次），通过后再议完整链路额度
process_amendments.note: 快筛通过时以该状态停机，等待预算裁定；阶段结果按 reuse key 复用，不重复扣费

review_amendments.reviewer: 项目负责人 + 审阅模型
changes: require_frozen_manifest 运行时重算规范体 SHA-256 并与 approval.frozen_sha256 比对，失配即阻断（含篡改测试）

模型记录拆分为 configured_models_at_protocol_freeze 与 observed_execution_models（保留原配置，不改历史）
stop_status 更名为 phase1_stop_status，新增 final_route_status
README 单元测试计数更新
产物入库策略：e_candidate_rule.json 原文与候选提示词转为本地忽略；新增去引文的 e_candidate_rule.public.json；etype_analysis/ 整目录本地化

route_conclusion.ruling: 接受收束：E 路线以无候选通过告终；候选 0/1 首评门拒绝，候选 2 Gate 0 拒绝；不晋升
route_conclusion.noise_reference: 基线 rerun 对 run1 在 17×3 上的最大正向 Δ 观测为 +1.0；两次 +2.0 命中超出该经验参考并被冻结首评门拒绝；这不构成对跑动方差的统计排除
